#### Veeam

**Credential Records**

This dashboard gives visibility into credential record events in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique users, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces top credential accounts and the users who create, update, or delete them. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a credentials-management view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
